messages.subject: Re: [stan] Feature/partial inits (issue #1069) (#1082)
parts:
[back on stan-dev, this time for real]

On Oct 16, 2014, at 4:51 PM, Jiqiang Guo <guo...@gmail.com> wrote:

> To be clear, there is no change of how var_context is used in general at all.

Right --- looking at the pull request, it's just the
behavior of var_context that changes. It looks well tested
and I can take on the code review for the var_context changes
(this pull request) over the weekend.

I think Daniel's concern was just that it changes user-facing
behavior and thus should be documented and tested through
all the interfaces.

I'm not sure it really needs tests through all the interfaces,
though. The whole point of pulling back implementations into
Stan itself was that it would separate these concerns.

- Bob
